transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Nimbus Telecom. My name is Lucy. How can I help you today?
Customer: Hi Lucy, I'm Aisha Wilson. I'm calling because I've had enough of the constant signal drops in my area. I want to cancel my service.
Agent: I am very sorry to hear that you've been experiencing connectivity issues, Ms. Wilson. I can certainly look into your account for you.
Customer: I just want it gone. I'm switching to a different provider who actually has coverage here.
Agent: I understand. Before we proceed with any account changes, could you please provide your account number?
Customer: My account number is 40682998 and my phone number is 97268 08975.
Agent: Thank you. I see your contract is still active. Please be aware that there is an early-termination fee of fifty dollars, and your final bill will arrive within thirty days of the cancellation date.
Customer: Fifty dollars? You're charging me to leave because your service is terrible? That is ridiculous!
Agent: I understand your frustration, but these are the standard terms of the agreement you signed.
Customer: I am not paying a penny of that fee. Just cancel the line now without the charge.
Agent: I'm afraid I don't have the authority to waive that early-termination fee, Ms. Wilson.
Customer: This is unbelievable. I've been a customer for years and you're treating me like this. I'm absolutely disgusted with this company!
Agent: I apologize for the inconvenience. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Customer: No, nothing else. You've made it worse.
